dutyholderOrTrigger: Responsible person for most non-domestic premises
requiredOutcome: Suitable and sufficient recorded assessment; precautions; regular review
externalPaidProvision: Conditional: simple low-risk premises may be self-assessed; competent help is needed where expertise or time is absent
competenceOrAccreditation: Competence matched to premises; government prefers registered or third-party-certified assessors for external appointments
cadenceOrTrigger: Regular review and material-change triggers; no universal annual purchase stated
aiBoundary: AI may structure notes and draft actions but cannot observe all premises conditions or inherit the responsible person's duty
limitations: Premises risk and responsible-person allocation require case-specific analysis

dutyholderOrTrigger: Responsible person under the Fire Safety Order
requiredOutcome: Assessment precautions records and regular review
externalPaidProvision: Conditional: competent self-assessment is possible; third-party certification is recommended when appointing externally
aiBoundary: Jurisdiction-aware assistance only; final adequacy and responsibility remain human
limitations: Welsh guidance must be applied rather than assuming England wording

dutyholderOrTrigger: Employer or other dutyholder with control of non-domestic premises
requiredOutcome: Assess fire risk and implement appropriate measures
externalPaidProvision: Conditional: external suitably qualified help where internal capability is insufficient
competenceOrAccreditation: Scottish guidance recommends registered or third-party-certified assessors
cadenceOrTrigger: Review when no longer valid and under applicable guidance
aiBoundary: AI cannot replace premises-specific assessment; generic assessment is explicitly insufficient
limitations: Fire Scotland Act and regulations differ from England and Wales

dutyholderOrTrigger: Employer owner or occupier responsible for non-domestic premises
requiredOutcome: Suitably competent person completes and reviews assessment
externalPaidProvision: Conditional: small uncomplicated businesses can use guidance; complex premises need specialist help
competenceOrAccreditation: Suitably competent person matched to complexity
aiBoundary: AI can assist documentation but cannot create competence or conduct a complete physical assessment
limitations: Northern Ireland order and regulations differ from Great Britain

dutyholderOrTrigger: Owner landlord tenant or managing agent with maintenance or repair responsibility for non-domestic premises
requiredOutcome: Determine presence and condition; assess and manage risk; maintain register and plan where applicable
externalPaidProvision: Often but not universally: dutyholder can use existing reliable information; intrusive knowledge and sampling need competent providers
competenceOrAccreditation: HSE strongly recommends UKAS-accredited survey organisations; sample analysis must be accredited
cadenceOrTrigger: Initial determination; building-work and condition-change triggers; ongoing management and monitoring
aiBoundary: AI may index registers and plans; it cannot inspect concealed material take samples or perform accredited analysis
limitations: The lease and planned work change the duty and survey type

dutyholderOrTrigger: Employer or controller of work equipment
requiredOutcome: Maintain electrical equipment to prevent danger
externalPaidProvision: Not structurally required for every annual PAT cycle
competenceOrAccreditation: Competence proportionate to inspection or test
cadenceOrTrigger: Risk-based rather than a universal annual test
aiBoundary: AI can schedule risk-based checks and detect missing records; it must not invent a statutory annual requirement
limitations: Fixed installations and high-risk environments need separate treatment

dutyholderOrTrigger: Employer landlord or controller depending on fitting and premises
requiredOutcome: Safe installation maintenance and work by qualified people
externalPaidProvision: Required for covered gas work: unregistered AI or general staff cannot perform it
competenceOrAccreditation: Gas Safe registration and correct qualification for the work
cadenceOrTrigger: Maintenance and checks depend on context; residential landlord annual rules do not map wholesale to non-residential premises
aiBoundary: AI can extract asset records schedule work and prefill jobs; physical gas work remains registered work
limitations: Industrial plant and landlord arrangements can invoke different rules

dutyholderOrTrigger: Employer or person in control of premises and water systems
requiredOutcome: Assess risk; appoint competent responsible person; control monitor record and review where risk exists
externalPaidProvision: Conditional: competent internal personnel may act; contractors do not remove dutyholder responsibility
competenceOrAccreditation: Sufficient authority skills knowledge and system experience; external scheme may help supplier selection
cadenceOrTrigger: Periodic and change-based; no universal certificate or fixed annual cycle for ordinary landlord systems
aiBoundary: AI may flag temperature anomalies and missing checks but cannot infer unobserved pipework or certify system control
limitations: Complex cooling healthcare and spa systems have materially different risk

dutyholderOrTrigger: Business owning operating or controlling lifting equipment used at work
requiredOutcome: Thorough examination and written reporting by a competent person in covered cases
externalPaidProvision: Usually creates external or independent competent-person spend although an adequately independent in-house person can qualify
competenceOrAccreditation: Practical and theoretical knowledge experience independence and impartiality
cadenceOrTrigger: Normally six months for equipment lifting people and accessories; twelve months for other lifting equipment or an examination scheme
aiBoundary: AI may schedule reconcile defects and draft notifications; it cannot perform the physical examination or independently judge defect severity
limitations: Not all transport equipment is LOLER lifting equipment; exceptional events add examinations

dutyholderOrTrigger: Owner or user of qualifying pressure equipment
requiredOutcome: Written scheme before use and examinations under that scheme
externalPaidProvision: Strong external-spend lane where in-house independence and competence are unavailable
competenceOrAccreditation: Competent person with authority expertise and independence
cadenceOrTrigger: Scheme-defined and before operation plus required examinations
aiBoundary: AI may retrieve the scheme compare readings and track due work; competent person retains scheme and examination responsibility
limitations: Only qualifying systems and relevant fluids are covered

dutyholderOrTrigger: Seller landlord or developer when EPC trigger applies; covered private non-domestic landlord for MEES
requiredOutcome: Valid EPC from accredited assessor; covered rented property generally at least EPC E or valid exemption
externalPaidProvision: Accredited assessor is required for EPC; improvement work depends on rating coverage cost effectiveness and exemptions
competenceOrAccreditation: Accredited non-domestic energy assessor directs and verifies evidence collection
cadenceOrTrigger: EPC and transaction triggers; current MEES E; proposed larger-building EPC B from 2031 is not yet law
aiBoundary: AI may extract plans and model options but remote lodgement without assessor-directed verified data is unacceptable
limitations: Scotland and Northern Ireland have separate regimes; 2031 proposal depends on legislation
